params.name: panel_t
params.comment: printed wall thickness (PETG); 2-4 mm

params.name: fit_gap
params.comment: per side, housing cavity over the plate edges; 0.1-0.5 mm

params.name: x_half
params.comment: plate / housing inner half-width (back wall inside at -x_half, front at +x_half); 45-70 mm

params.name: r_long
params.comment: outer radius of the top-back long edge, and size of the 45 deg top-front chamfer; both go with the hood, so 8-13 mm leaves the shell unchanged

params.name: r_bottom
params.comment: outer radius of the two bottom long edges (the door's rounded edges); panel_t+2 .. 12 mm

params.name: plate_top
params.comment: world y of the plate's top edge (feed_unit PLATE_TOP, from the guard and standoffs)

params.name: plate_bot
params.comment: world y of the plate's bottom edge (feed_unit PLATE_BOT, from the module and tray)

params.name: w_shell0
params.comment: W of the housing's open rim on the plate edges (plate outer face minus the lap)

params.name: plate_out
params.comment: W of the plate's outer face: the rails start here; > w_shell0

params.name: cap_cut
params.comment: W where the end cap starts: shell, hood and door end here (each prints on a MK3S); 230-260 mm

params.name: rail
params.comment: printed rails carrying the hood's M3 heat-set inserts (square section); 8-12 mm

params.name: band_y
params.comment: world y of the bottom of the hood's control strip (top of the shell's front wall)

params.name: knuckle_r
params.comment: hinge knuckle radius (on a 3 mm steel pin); 3-4 mm

params.name: lap
params.comment: end-cap seam lap length over the shell's stepped walls; 5-10 mm

params.name: lap_t
params.comment: end cap's lap skin thickness; < panel_t/2

params.name: lap_g
params.comment: clearance under the end cap's lap; 0.1-0.4 mm

params.name: split_y
params.comment: derived: door / shell split, top of the bottom fillets

params.name: hinge_x
params.comment: derived: hinge pin axis, 0.75 outside the back wall, on the split line

params.name: chamfer_in
params.comment: derived: inside legs of the housing's top 45 deg chamfers

params.name: pcb_x0
params.comment: world x of the PCB's x=0 edge (feed_unit f.pcb_x0)

params.name: pcb_y
params.comment: world y of the PCB's underside = top of its 4 bosses

params.name: pcb_w0
params.comment: world W of the PCB's y=0 edge; its holes are 4 mm in from a 100 x 100 board's corners

params.name: insert_d
params.comment: M3 heat-set insert hole diameter (Kadrick M3x5: 4.0)

params.name: insert_l
params.comment: M3 heat-set insert hole depth (insert + 1)

params.name: intake_w0
params.comment: W where the motor-air louvre fields start (back and front walls)

params.name: intake_w1
params.comment: W where the louvre fields end

params.name: intake_y0
params.comment: world y of the louvre blocks' bottom (4 slots, 6 mm pitch, from intake_y0 + 5)

params.name: intake_y1
params.comment: world y of the louvre blocks' top

params.name: fan_w0
params.comment: W where the 40 mm fan / exhaust louvre block starts (back wall)

params.name: fan_w1
params.comment: W where the fan block ends

params.name: fan_y0
params.comment: world y of the fan block's bottom (6 slots, 5.5 mm pitch, from fan_y0 + 4)

params.name: fan_y1
params.comment: world y of the fan block's top

params.name: fan_screw_d
params.comment: fan screw holes (self-tapping M3 into the louvre block); 2.4-2.8 mm
